concerns.text: Task T032b ('Generate VLA Proxy Baseline') is marked [ ] (incomplete) and lacks a concrete implementation description or dependency resolution strategy. FR-005 and SC-002 require a 'random sampling baseline' and a 'VLA proxy' for comparison. While T032a attempts to load a proxy, T032b is the only task addressing its generation if missing, yet it is incomplete. Without a defined task to generate or load this critical baseline artifact, FR-005 (simulation execution against baselines) and SC-002 (success rate comparison) cannot be satisfied.

Task T018 ('Verify clustering coverage: Ensure ≥ 98%...') is marked [ ] (incomplete). FR-002a and SC-005 explicitly require verifying that ≥ 98% of ingested samples are assigned to exactly one cluster. T018 is the only task addressing this verification metric. Its incomplete status means the spec requirement for clustering coverage validation is unimplemented.

Task T026 ('Validate inference performance: Ensure memory < 7GB...') is marked [ ] (incomplete). SC-003 requires measuring computational cost (memory/time) against GitHub Actions constraints. T026 is the sole task for this validation. Without it, the plan cannot verify compliance with SC-003.

Task T036 ('Calculate trajectory fidelity metric') is marked [ ] (incomplete). SC-001 requires measuring trajectory fidelity against the VLA proxy. T036 is the only task explicitly calculating this metric. Its absence leaves SC-001 unverified.

Task T037 ('Generate final report') is marked [ ] (incomplete). The plan and spec require a final report containing p-values, confidence intervals, and fidelity metrics. T037 is the designated task for this output. Without it, the research deliverable is incomplete.

Task T001a ('Create directory structure') and T001e ('Create tests placeholder') are marked [ ] (incomplete). While T001b-d are checked, the foundational directory structure (T001a) and test placeholders (T001e) are prerequisites for the entire pipeline. Their incomplete status blocks the 'Setup' phase completion required before 'Foundational' work can proceed.

Task T027 ('Save trained CGMM models and BERT encoder') is marked [ ] (incomplete). T023-T025 (Inference) depend on these artifacts (T027). Without saving the models, the inference engine (FR-004) cannot function, breaking the dependency chain for US-02.

Task T034 ('Log simulation results to CSV') is marked [ ] (incomplete). FR-005 requires recording success rates and collision counts. T034 is the specific task for logging these results to `data/results/simulation_logs.csv`. Without this, the data required for T035 (McNemar's Test) and SC-002 is missing.
